whiteboard.title: Whiteboard
whiteboard.adaptingLabel: Adapting the play around your changes…
whiteboard.moveHint: Drag a player or arrow end · tap an end to delete
whiteboard.addMovementHint: What is this? It’s added to {{scheme}} and included when you tap Adapt play.
whiteboard.refineHint: Describe the change and the AI will redraw the play (offense, defense, counter, and key). Your hand-drawn marks are kept.
whiteboard.refinePlaceholder: e.g. add a weak-side flare, roller should short-roll, bring the 5 to the top...
whiteboard.playersHint: Each player's detail is how the AI read your play for them. Edit any of them and/or lock a player in place (the AI cascades the others around a lock), then Apply & Regenerate.
whiteboard.noPlayersYet: No players in this scheme yet.
whiteboard.noDefendersYet: No defenders in this scheme yet.
whiteboard.cascadingLabel: Cascading the play around your locks…
whiteboard.nothingToApplyMsg: Lock a player or edit their detail first.
whiteboard.aiHint: Describe the scene or play — what was run, what the defense did, what went wrong. The AI draws the offense, defense, and counter, plus a key of what would have made it work.
whiteboard.aiPlaceholder: e.g. High P&R left, their big hedged hard, roller was open but the pass came late, weak-side corner never lifted...
whiteboard.byPlayerCta: By Player — set roles for O1–O5 / D1–D5
whiteboard.byPlayerHint: Set what any player should do — offense (O1–O5) or defense (D1–D5). Leave the rest blank. The AI builds the play from these, and you can fine-tune per player afterward.
whiteboard.scoutReportDesc: Opponent scouting from the Team Grade scout section
whiteboard.teamReportDesc: Reports you created in the Team Reports section
whiteboard.noScoutReports: No opponent scouting reports yet — generate one from the Team Grade scout section.
whiteboard.noTeamReports: No team reports yet — create one in the Team Reports section.
